I've actually been here a couple of times already before writing this review, and honestly I wouldn't highly recommend this coffee shop due to its slow food preparation process, where my friends and I usually have to wait for over 30 minutes for our meals (which happened earlier today). However, I'm writing this review in appreciation and gratitude for their staff on duty today. Story time: My friends and I went here to eat breakfast. We ordered our food and waited more than 30 minutes for the food and free WiFi coupon. By the time my food arrived (which was cornsilog), I ate it and it tasted sour, which didn't make sense at all since it's corned beef (How can corned beef be sour?). Even upon deciding to finish it, my friends called the attention of the server/chef and asked why the corned beef was sour (shout out to my friends!). The chef then apologized profusely and offered to prepare a fresh batch. After serving the fresh batch (upgraded my white rice to java rice), not only did he apologize once again, he also brought the staff in training (the one who cooked my first meal—the sour one) to apologize to me as well. I'm genuinely amazed with their service and accountability, which is why I wanted to write this review and let everyone who plans to visit here that despite the slow service, I hope you'll still choose to visit this place. 🫶🫶

Labeled as a "24-hour" café, yet many items are unavailable. Exploring cafés that are ideal for virtual assistants like me has become a hobby. When I first arrived, I asked for a hot coffee, but the staff told me that all hot beverages and coffee-based drinks were unavailable. I let it slide and ordered a cold matcha instead. About 20 minutes later, I decided to get a slice of cake, only to be told that the cakes on display were not for sale yet. Again, I brushed it off. Finally, as my mobile data was running low, I asked for the Wi-Fi password—only to be told that Wi-Fi wasn't available either. The staff was polite, but the lack of essential services in a so-called "24-hour" café was a huge disappointment. Not recommended better go to Magallanes Barrok Cafe they have better services.
